query:
-- Ajouter des liaisons pour les aldéhydes et alcools terpéniques
INSERT IGNORE INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage, part_used, notes, created_at)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 
  CASE 
    WHEN m.name LIKE '%aldehyde%' THEN 5.0
    WHEN m.name LIKE '%ol' THEN 15.0
    ELSE 10.0
  END,
  'huile essentielle',
  CONCAT('Composant de ', p.name),
  NOW()
FROM molecules m
CROSS JOIN plants p
WHERE m.id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM plant_molecules)
AND (
  -- Citrus pour les aldéhydes citriques
  (m.name LIKE '%citral%' AND p.name LIKE '%Citrus%' AND p.name LIKE '%limon%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%citronellal%' AND p.name LIKE '%Cymbopogon%')
  -- Rose pour les alcools floraux
  OR (m.name LIKE '%geraniol%' AND p.name LIKE '%Rosa%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%citronellol%' AND p.name LIKE '%Rosa%')
  -- Menthe pour les composés mentholés
  OR (m.name LIKE '%menthol%' AND p.name LIKE '%Mentha%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%menthone%' AND p.name LIKE '%Mentha%')
  -- Eucalyptus pour eucalyptol
  OR (m.name LIKE '%eucalyptol%' AND p.name LIKE '%Eucalyptus%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%cineole%' AND p.name LIKE '%Eucalyptus%')
)
LIMIT 50;
